newsitem.title: MEXICO: New ecological fund for Mexican small business.
newsitem.headline: New ecological fund for Mexican small business.

text.p: The Commission for Environmental Cooperation (CCA) and the Mexican Confederation of Industry Chambers announced on Friday the setting up of a fund to finance ecological projects for small and medium-sized businesses.
The fund will have $200,000 available from the Mexican Foundation for Innovation and Technology Transfer (Funtec), which also took part in setting it up.
Funtec said in a news release that the program envisages setting up similar funds in the U.S. and Canada.
The CCA is financed in equal proportions by Mexico, the U.S. and Canada within the framework of the North American Free Trade Agreement.
